day_shape: 90 items: UNSC adopts presidential statement condemning Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, Trump names Iran's Pickaxe Mountain as possible strike target, CENTCOM rebuts three IRGC Hormuz claims, Lavrov Tehran visit set for 19 October, heavy regime Sinwar-anniversary and 'Baath' IRGC messaging.

threads.label: Iran nuclear and Hezbollah war warning
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post reported Trump confirmed the US is examining Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site as a possible strike target, and that Iran told Hezbollah to prepare for war on the assessment further US strikes are 'only a matter of time'. Rubio spoke with Lebanese President Aoun urging accountability for those behind a seizure of hundreds of kilograms of explosives linked to Hezbollah, which Hezbollah appeared to claim.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz and CENTCOM posture
threads.summary: CENTCOM published a rebuttal of three IRGC claims in 24 hours, including continued IRGC assertions of control over the Strait of Hormuz and a claim that a Singapore-flagged container ship struck a mine. CENTCOM also posted imagery of USS George H.W. Bush patrolling the Arabian Sea and F-16s operating from a Middle East base.

threads.label: Yemen, Houthis and Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: The UN Security Council adopted a presidential statement strongly condemning escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia affecting civilian aviation and energy infrastructure. Defa Press and IRIB carried Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree declaring any Saudi military presence a legitimate target after a reported strike on a Saudi command centre in Aden, with witnesses reporting booms near Aden's presidential palace.

threads.label: Gaza strikes and Sinwar anniversary
threads.summary: The IDF announced it killed Hamas October 7 participant Mohammed Abd al-Khalek Hala and PIJ operative Ahmad Jabrin Dalhan, plus two weapons smugglers in Khan Younis, and released documents and a letter it attributes to Yahya Sinwar's 10-year-old son marking two years since Sinwar's killing. The UNSC held its quarterly open debate on Gaza and the West Bank, and Nickolay Mladenov condemned the suspension of private-sector goods coordination into Gaza after reported Hamas coercion.

threads.label: Iran regime messaging and diplomacy
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press carried the army spokesman claiming air-defence coverage has been 'greatly strengthened' since the war, the launch of an IRGC 'Baath' charity exercise distributing 313,000 packages in Tehran, and Khamenei's office warning against 'demoralising' statements. IRIB announced Russian FM Lavrov will visit Tehran on 19 October, and Pezeshkian met the UN Secretary-General and Armenia's PM and addressed the CBD COP17.

threads.label: Israel-Iran covert and regional theatre
threads.summary: At a London court, a suspect in an alleged plot against Iran International journalists said a UK-based IRGC officer threatened to kill him, and Iran International disclosed a cyberattack on one of its correspondents' accounts. Iranian, Turkish, Kuwaiti, Pakistani and PA representatives walked out of Israeli President Herzog's CICA speech in Baku, which Defa Press said Herzog reached via an Azerbaijani aircraft bypassing Turkey's flight ban.

threads.label: US sanctions and Iran domestic pressures
threads.summary: The State Department announced sanctions on Cuba's state-owned Banco Internacional de Comercio, and Iran International reported fresh US Treasury warnings over Iran's alleged abuse of overseas religious charities. Iran International also reported Tehran mayor Zakani freezing basic food prices amid presidential-bid speculation, a reformist-reported arrest over an alleged plot against a former minister, and central-bank denials of economic collapse as households struggle with basics.

events.summary_en: Moasat, charitable assistance and dowry-giving exercise titled 'Baath' has begun. The largest exercise for mutual aid, charitable assistance and dowry-giving, titled 'Baath', centred on the 'Martyrs of Iran', was launched today by the Mohammad Rasul Allah (PBUH) IRGC from Imam Hussain Square to Revolution Square in Tehran. This programme has been designed with a different perspective and is intended to coordinate various popular capacities including market, craftspeople, mosques, societies, schools, students and field gatherings in a joint coordinated effort to provide fitting assistance while maintaining dignity to target families. Food packages include essential items such as rice, legumes, pasta, tomato paste, sugar, candy, canned fish and oil.
